description: This signal is raised when a service provider or contractor contract fails to include provisions requiring cooperation with consumer deletion requests. CCPA grants consumers the right to request deletion of their personal information, and businesses must direct service providers and contractors who received the data to also delete it unless an exception applies.
applicability: Service provider and contractor contracts lacking deletion cooperation clauses Vendor agreements that need to support consumer rights fulfillment Data processing chains where deletion requests must be propagated Consumer privacy rights management systems

metadata.detection_notes: Review CCPA compliance documentation and controls for CONTRACTS requirements.
